comments.text:
Wait, I thought you had a garden, so why would you need to go to Walmart for "everyday produce?"  I can understand stuff that doesn't grow where you are like kiwi, etc., but I'm confused.  I thought you were big on gardening, canning, freezing, etc. to have it all year around.

Also, just asking, since I only go to Walmart every 90 days for one prescription, do they have a good selection of organic produce?  I don't remember the one by me having much other than straggly looking random produce even though it's a Super Walmart.
